name: mint-product-style
title_zh: 薄荷绿底配深色字，原型图自带清爽高级感
tagline_zh: 受够了灰白黑原型像半成品？这套薄荷配色让低保真页面也有成品质感，按钮、卡片、状态条全配好，拖进去就能演示。
tagline_en: Tired of gray wireframes that look unfinished? This mint palette makes low-fi mockups feel polished—buttons.

why_zh: 不是简单换色，而是把薄荷绿作为强调色与背景色的平衡体系，深灰文字保证可读性。
why_en: Not just a color swap—it balances mint accents with deep-gray text for readability, plus consistent spacing and radius so.
